title: ActorTaskCreateRequest
description: actor.task-create-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/tasks on OpenVibe.Actor (capability actor.task.create), the creation subset of platform.task@1. TASK is the instruction in plain words. MODE is the planner objective (default balanced). BUDGET caps what this task may cost (per_task_usd) and what the caller's tasks may cost in one UTC day (per_day_usd); either may be left out for the person's free-allowance defaults, and a value above the person's tier is refused 422 actor.budget.over_tier, never silently lowered. AGENT pins one agent system by its id from GET /api/v1/agents (routing still checks that it can take the task). IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: a repeat from the same requester within 24 h with an identical body answers the first task (200), with a different body 409 actor.idempotency.conflict.

agent.description: An agent system id from GET /api/v1/agents.

examples.task: Find out who runs the mail for openvibe.network and whether its SPF and DMARC are set up properly.
